name: bento-cascade-hero
title: Bento Cascade Hero
author: AlgorizeTech
description: An infinite vertical bento marquee hero section that loops seamlessly on the browser compositor. Staggered multi-column cards, rich media tiles, soft edge fade masks, and responsive motion with zero visible reset jumps.
docs: Named export: BentoCascadeHero (also available as variant='bento-cascade' in HeroBlock). Pass `title`, `titleAccent`, `subtitle`, `badgeText`, `primaryActionLabel`, `secondaryActionLabel`, `cards`, `images`, `speed`, and `pauseOnHover`.
